narrative_intent: Stylized impact beat: the house itself reacts. Deliberately breaks the naturalistic grammar of the rest of the film for two seconds.
setting: The kitchen interior, seen from outside the broken window as the room inverts upward.
action: Every loose object in the room lifts and hangs motionless in the air; the camera drops to floor level looking up through the glass.
lighting: the room's own light flips cold and hard from below, edges blooming, no visible practical source
style_grade: high-contrast graphic poster look, heavy letterbox vignette, crushed blacks, saturated cyan cast

camera.movement: fast tilt down into a floor-level hold, then a hard stop
camera.lens_feel: 24mm, pronounced barrel distortion at the frame edge

entities.name: Maya
entities.description: woman, mid-30s, shoulder-length dark hair parted left, grey knit sweater, silver ring on the right hand
entities.expression_cues: frozen mid-reach, hair lifted clear of her shoulders

entities.name: Kitchen

audio.ambience: all room tone drops out, leaving a ringing pressure
audio.sfx: a single low impact, then nothing
